description: 🚀 The Orbiters is a team passionate about space exploration and innovation. For the Space Mission Design Game challenge, we aim to create an interactive gaming experience where players can design space missions, explore planets, manage resources, and make strategic decisions. 🪐 Combining science, coding, AI, and storytelling, we want to make space exploration fun and educational. 🌌 नई सोच, नई उड़ान, अनंत ब्रह्मांड! ✨
